subject: New demo booked
body:
ID: 312 - christian Frisch (christian@daliacare.com) from Dalia on 2024-10-02
Topic: We are a small startup in the Mental Health domain. We are about to launch a study following 2000 patients wearing a fitbit and responding to questionnaires on a 6 month period.
We would be interested in a demo of your product. But before this, it would be useful to have an idea of a budget for both a SaaS or an self hosted version of your solution.
Best regards,
Christian
